_notice: Catalog of Saudi regulatory SOURCES for governance tracking only. Listing a source here does NOT make any derived value official. Draft and consultation entries are never binding. Rule candidates generated from this catalog remain inactive drafts until a licensed professional validates the exact clause against the official published document. URLs verified against official government sites on 2026-07-24; exact clause text must always be taken from the official publications themselves.

priorities.P0: Core building-code and code-application-law sources required for the preliminary structural/architectural review scope
priorities.P1: Municipal, permitting, licensing, and safety-authority sources required for permit-readiness scoring
priorities.P2: Supporting, sector-specific, regional, or upcoming sources tracked for roadmap coverage

resources.title_ar: كود البناء السعودي العام (SBC 201)
resources.title_en: Saudi Building Code — General (SBC 201)
resources.notes: General provisions: architectural requirements, sanitation, ventilation. A 2024 edition is listed on sbc.gov.sa. Exact clause text must be taken from the official publication.

resources.title_ar: الكود السعودي الإنشائي - الأحمال والقوى (SBC 301)
resources.title_en: Saudi Building Code — Structural: Loading and Forces (SBC 301)
resources.notes: Structural loading provisions; out of MVP automated scope, tracked for roadmap.

resources.title_ar: الكود السعودي الإنشائي - التشييد (SBC 302)
resources.title_en: Saudi Building Code — Structural: Construction (SBC 302)
resources.notes: Construction and testing requirements for structural works.

resources.title_ar: الكود السعودي الإنشائي - التربة والأساسات (SBC 303)
resources.title_en: Saudi Building Code — Structural: Soils and Foundations (SBC 303)
resources.notes: Basis for the soil-report requirement in the permit checklist.

resources.title_ar: الكود السعودي الإنشائي - الخرسانة (SBC 304)
resources.title_en: Saudi Building Code — Structural: Concrete Structures (SBC 304)
resources.notes: Concrete design/detailing provisions; roadmap scope for structural review.

resources.title_ar: الكود السعودي الإنشائي - المباني الخرسانية المسلحة بالطوب (SBC 305)
resources.title_en: Saudi Building Code — Structural: Masonry (SBC 305)
resources.notes: Masonry provisions; tracked for roadmap coverage.

resources.title_ar: الكود السعودي الإنشائي - المنشآت الفولاذية (SBC 306)
resources.title_en: Saudi Building Code — Structural: Steel Structures (SBC 306)
resources.notes: Steel provisions; tracked for roadmap coverage.

resources.title_ar: الكود السعودي الكهربائي (SBC 401)
resources.title_en: Saudi Building Code — Electrical (SBC 401)
resources.notes: Electrical installations; pairs with SEC service-connection requirements.

resources.title_ar: الكود السعودي الميكانيكي (SBC 501)
resources.title_en: Saudi Building Code — Mechanical (SBC 501)
resources.notes: HVAC and mechanical systems requirements.

resources.title_ar: كود ترشيد الطاقة السعودي (SBC 601)
resources.title_en: Saudi Building Code — Energy Conservation (SBC 601)
resources.notes: Thermal insulation requirements apply to all new construction under the SBC application law. Basis of the energy-compliance checklist item.

resources.title_ar: الكود السعودي للتمديدات الصحية (SBC 701)
resources.title_en: Saudi Building Code — Plumbing (SBC 701)
resources.notes: Plumbing/sanitary provisions; pairs with NWC connection requirements.

resources.title_ar: الكود السعودي للحماية من الحريق (SBC 801)
resources.title_en: Saudi Building Code — Fire Protection (SBC 801)
resources.notes: Fire protection requirements apply to all new construction under the SBC application law. Civil Defense approval remains a separate mandatory process.

resources.title_ar: الكود السعودي للمباني القائمة (SBC 901)
resources.title_en: Saudi Building Code — Existing Buildings (SBC 901)
resources.notes: Renovation/change-of-use scope; tracked for roadmap coverage.

resources.title_ar: الكود السعودي للمباني السكنية - الجزء الأول (SBC 1101)
resources.title_en: Saudi Residential Building Code — Volume 1 (SBC 1101)
resources.notes: Primary source for villa/residential preliminary checks: administrative and architectural provisions, egress, sanitation. 2018 edition table of contents verified on sbc.gov.sa.

resources.title_ar: الكود السعودي للمباني السكنية - الجزء الثاني (SBC 1102)
resources.title_en: Saudi Residential Building Code — Volume 2 (SBC 1102)
resources.notes: Companion residential volume (structural/MEP aspects of low-rise residential buildings).

resources.title_ar: نظام تطبيق كود البناء السعودي
resources.title_en: Saudi Building Code Application Law
resources.issuer: Ministry of Municipalities and Housing (published law)
resources.notes: The law making SBC application mandatory by building classification phases; fire-protection and thermal-insulation requirements apply immediately to all new construction.

resources.title_ar: اللائحة التنفيذية لنظام تطبيق كود البناء السعودي
resources.title_en: Executive Regulation of the Saudi Building Code Application Law
resources.source_reference: https://momah.gov.sa/en/node/15415 (also published in Umm Al-Qura gazette: https://uqn.gov.sa/?p=22104)
resources.notes: Defines plan review, permit issuance, inspection, and enforcement duties. An updated PDF (2025-10) is published on momah.gov.sa.

resources.title_ar: خدمة إصدار رخصة بناء عبر منصة بلدي
resources.title_en: Building license issuance service (Balady platform)
resources.issuer: Ministry of Municipalities and Housing / Balady
resources.notes: Official channel for permit issuance: requires updated electronic deed, certified survey, SBC-compliant design, licensed engineering office supervision contract. License validity 3 years. Basis of the permit-readiness checklist.

resources.title_ar: اشتراطات البناء البلدية عبر منصة بلدي
resources.title_en: Municipal building requirements (Balady platform)
resources.issuer: Ministry of Municipalities and Housing / Balady
resources.notes: Setbacks, coverage, floors vary per municipality and district. Values must be pulled per project location — never generalized.

resources.title_ar: أدلة إجراءات رخص البناء - وزارة البلديات والإسكان
resources.title_en: Building permit procedure guides (Ministry of Municipalities and Housing)
resources.source_reference: https://momah.gov.sa — published guides and regulations library
resources.notes: Procedural guidance for the permit-readiness checklist; not a technical code.

resources.title_ar: الدليل الإرشادي لاشتراطات رخص البناء - أمانة منطقة الرياض
resources.title_en: Building license requirements guide — Riyadh Region Municipality (Amanah)
resources.notes: Riyadh-specific license requirements and zoning conditions. Regional scope: applies inside Riyadh Amanah jurisdiction only.

resources.title_ar: ضوابط المخططات العمرانية الجديدة - أمانة منطقة الرياض
resources.title_en: New urban subdivision controls — Riyadh Region Municipality
resources.notes: Infrastructure and public-realm completion required before construction starts in new subdivisions (paving, lighting, water, sewage, electricity, telecom, landscaping).

resources.title_ar: الأنظمة واللوائح - الهيئة الملكية لمدينة الرياض
resources.title_en: Regulations — Royal Commission for Riyadh City (RCRC)
resources.notes: Urban development policies and building regulations for Riyadh city under RCRC mandate; must be checked for projects in RCRC-governed areas.

resources.title_ar: كود وادي حنيفة العمراني - الهيئة الملكية لمدينة الرياض
resources.title_en: Wadi Hanifa Urban Code (RCRC)
resources.notes: District-scope urban form and facade controls for the Wadi Hanifa corridor; applies only within its defined boundary.

resources.title_ar: اشتراطات السلامة - المديرية العامة للدفاع المدني
resources.title_en: Safety requirements — General Directorate of Civil Defense
resources.notes: Safety approvals issued only by Civil Defense; the system only tracks readiness. Works with SBC 801 fire provisions.

resources.title_ar: بوابة سلامة لتراخيص السلامة (الدفاع المدني)
resources.title_en: Salamah portal for safety licenses (Civil Defense)
resources.notes: Official electronic issuance/renewal of Civil Defense safety licenses for establishments with commercial registrations. Relevant to commercial-activity permit readiness.

resources.title_ar: اعتماد وترخيص المكاتب الهندسية - الهيئة السعودية للمهندسين
resources.title_en: Engineering office licensing — Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE)
resources.notes: Professional accreditation and engineering-office licensing. Basis of the licensed-engineering-office checklist item and of the validated_by requirement in the rule workflow.

resources.title_ar: جهات تقويم المطابقة المقبولة لكود البناء السعودي - هيئة المواصفات
resources.title_en: Accepted conformity assessment bodies for the SBC (SASO)
resources.issuer: Saudi Standards, Metrology and Quality Organization (SASO)
resources.notes: List of accepted inspection/conformity bodies for SBC compliance; useful for pilot customers selecting inspection partners.

resources.title_ar: اشتراطات توصيل المياه والصرف الصحي - شركة المياه الوطنية
resources.title_en: Water and sewage connection requirements (National Water Company)
resources.notes: Owner-submitted connection request with ~10 required documents; property must be free of debt with water/sewage outlets prepared. Utility checklist item.

resources.title_ar: اشتراطات إيصال الخدمة الكهربائية - الشركة السعودية للكهرباء
resources.title_en: Electrical service connection requirements (Saudi Electricity Company)
resources.notes: Permanent service connection requirements and the SEC guide for engineering offices. Utility checklist item; pairs with SBC 401.

resources.title_ar: خدمات رخص البناء عبر المنصة الوطنية الموحدة GOV.SA
resources.title_en: Building permit services on the national unified platform (GOV.SA)
resources.notes: Aggregator entry point to Balady/SCE services; useful for citizen-facing guidance links.

resources.title_ar: مسودة تحديثات كود البناء السعودي (قيد المراجعة)
resources.title_en: Draft Saudi Building Code updates (under review)
resources.notes: DRAFT — must never be treated as binding or exported as an active rule.

resources.title_ar: مشاريع أنظمة تحت الاستطلاع العام (منصة استطلاع)
resources.title_en: Regulations under public consultation (Istitlaa platform)
resources.notes: CONSULTATION — tracked for awareness only; never binding, never exported. Municipal code/guide consultations appear here (e.g. istitlaa.ncc.gov.sa/ar/Municipality/momra).
